simulations.scenario: A circuit in the electrical-workers hall needs a new outlet. Walk the safe isolation sequence before any work.

scoring.notes: Pass: isolation, prove-dead and lock-off in order, with the meter test recorded. Fail: any work before isolation, or a skipped test.

steps.action: Put on PPE: eye protection, insulated gloves, hi-vis.
steps.check: PPE on before any tool is picked up.

steps.action: Find the isolation point and open it.
steps.check: Correct circuit isolated; nothing else disturbed.
steps.if_wrong: Re-check the board labels and try again.

steps.action: Prove dead with the voltage tester on the circuit.
steps.check: Tester shows dead; test the tester first on a known live source.
steps.if_wrong: Do not proceed — re-test and re-isolate.

steps.action: Lock off and tag the isolation point.
steps.check: Lock and tag in place; only you hold the key.

steps.action: Fit the outlet, then test and restore.
steps.check: Test passes; restore in reverse order; record the reading.

scoring.notes: Pass: plan, chart check, rigging inspection and signal discipline all complete. Fail: lifting without a plan or with uninspected rigging.

steps.action: Write the lift plan: load, radius, ground conditions, spotter.
steps.check: Plan written and read back by the spotter.

steps.action: Check the load chart for the radius and capacity.
steps.check: Load is within chart capacity at that radius.
steps.if_wrong: Reduce the load or shorten the radius.

steps.action: Inspect slings, shackles and tag lines.
steps.check: No damage, correct ratings, tag lines attached.

steps.action: Signal the lift: one signal at a time, stop means stop.
steps.check: Signals clear; load lands on the mark.
